# YuE2 Music Cover — Auto Vocal PRO V2

Preserved: LoadAudio → SheetSage2 → YuE2GenerateMusic → KSampler → VAEDecodeAudio → SaveAudioAdvanced.

Automatic fix: converts the 1-bar "Z4|" placeholders of SheetSage2 into correctly timed Vocal notes, even if Instrumental has 4 bars.

**section_policy = all_of_rest** by default: any vocal section including custom tags is converted, but instrumental-intent tags (intro, interlude, solo, outro) remain instrumental. `all_sections` truly includes those sections too. User overrides via vocal_tags / instrumental_tags.

Add any [section tag] to Lyrics; Lyrics passes unchanged into YuE2. ABC headings (% verse, % bridge, etc.) determine the score's musical structure; arbitrary lyrics tags are not guaranteed semantic controls for YuE2.

Inside the subgraph: `PreviewAny` before conversion (raw ABC), and after conversion (fixed ABC), plus a report with counts and warnings.

Set strict=TRUE to stop empty-vocal outputs when there are no eligible groups or lyrics. FULL vs MELODY selects YuE2's interpretation of the supplied ABC; FULL does not automatically create complex accompaniment if the sheet lacks chords.

Install custom_nodes/yue2_auto_vocal_pro, restart ComfyUI, then import this workflow. Enter your own Lyrics; the field is empty in this Git-ready workflow. Compare vocal transfer before generating a long song.
